title: calcitrapa solstitialis subsp. adami
intro: Calcitrapa solstitialis subsp. adami, commonly known as the solstice trap plant, is a subspecies of the calcitrapa solstitialis plant. The health benefits of Calcitrapa solstitialis subsp. adami include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of this plant are primarily attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
